translations.bsb: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”
translations.kjv: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Jehovah, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.
